question: For each match, considering every innings, please combine runs from both batsman scored and extra runs for each over, then identify the single over with the highest total runs, retrieve the bowler for that over from the ball by ball table, and calculate the average of these highest over totals across all matches, ensuring that all runs and bowler details are accurately reflected.
sql:
-- Full query: for each match, find the over with highest total runs, get the bowler, then average the total runs
WITH batsman_over AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, SUM(runs_scored) as batsman_runs
    FROM batsman_scored
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no
),
extra_over AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, SUM(extra_runs) as extra_runs
    FROM extra_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no
),
over_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(b.match_id, e.match_id) as match_id,
        COALESCE(b.over_id, e.over_id) as over_id,
        COALESCE(b.innings_no, e.innings_no) as innings_no,
        COALESCE(b.batsman_runs, 0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_over b
    FULL OUTER JOIN extra_over e 
        ON b.match_id = e.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = e.over_id 
        AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
),
top_over AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM over_totals
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
top_over_with_bowler AS (
    SELECT t.match_id, t.over_id, t.innings_no, t.total_runs, MIN(bb.bowler) as bowler
    FROM top_over t
    LEFT JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON t.match_id = bb.match_id AND t.over_id = bb.over_id AND t.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY t.match_id, t.over_id, t.innings_no, t.total_runs
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) as average_highest_over_total
FROM top_over_with_bowler
